content: Read pages 0, 1, 2 and 3 using json_query. Return only a JSON array of the four answer values in page order. The answer is in answer or result.value, the CSV answer column, or DATA answer=. Ignore diagnostics. Preserve accuracy while minimizing total model usage and elapsed time. Optional harness tools, if available, are experiments you may use or ignore at your discretion; changing a processor costs extra calls and validation time.
